name: GotechArk Announcement Bar
author: TechArk Solutions

sections.description:
Announcement Bar is a lightweight and flexible WordPress plugin that helps you display important messages at the top of your website. Whether you want to promote special offers, share announcements, or highlight key updates, this plugin allows you to create an attention-grabbing bar without disrupting the user experience. It is easy to set up and works seamlessly with any WordPress theme.

The plugin offers full customization options, including colors, typography, positioning, and dismiss behavior. You can control how and where the announcement bar appears, making it responsive across all devices. With secure, form-based styling controls, you can tailor the announcement bar to perfectly match your site’s design and branding.

Designed with performance and usability in mind, Announcement Bar follows WordPress coding standards and best practices. It is ideal for businesses, blogs, and marketing teams looking for a simple yet powerful way to communicate important messages and calls to action directly to their visitors.

Features

  • Display a customizable announcement bar at the top of your website
  • Sticky or non-sticky bar option
  • Dismissible announcement with close button
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly design
  • Custom background color, text color, font size, and typography options
  • Support for HTML means rich content and links
  • Add call-to-action buttons inside the announcement bar
  • Target announcements by screen size using responsive rules
  • Secure, form-based styling (Padding, Border Radius, Font Size)
  • Lightweight, fast, and optimized for performance
  • Follows WordPress coding standards and security best practices
  • Works seamlessly with any WordPress theme

How It Works

  1. Install & Activate the Plugin
    Install the Announcement Bar plugin from the WordPress admin and activate it. Once activated, a new Announcement Bar menu appears in your dashboard.

  2. Create Your Announcement
    Add your message using the built-in editor. You can include text, links, buttons, emojis, or basic HTML to highlight important updates, offers, or alerts.

  3. Customize the Design
    Adjust background color, text color, font size, font family, and spacing. Enable sticky behavior or make the bar dismissible with a close button.

  4. Control Visibility Rules
    Choose where the announcement appears—site-wide or on specific pages. Configure responsive rules to show or hide the bar based on screen width (desktop, tablet, mobile).

  5. Advanced Options
    Use the advanced styling fields to apply professional layouts without editing theme files.

  6. Publish & Go Live
    Save your settings, and the announcement bar instantly appears on the frontend according to your rules.

  7. Update Anytime
    Modify the content or settings at any time—changes are reflected immediately without needing to clear caches or redeploy code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the announcement-bar folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Announcement Bar in the WordPress admin area.
sections.faq:
Can I display the announcement bar on specific pages only?

Yes. You can choose to show the announcement bar site-wide or limit it to selected pages based on your requirements.

Is the announcement bar mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. The plugin supports responsive rules, allowing you to control visibility and styling for desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.

Can visitors close or dismiss the announcement bar?

Yes. You can enable a dismiss (close) button so users can hide the bar after viewing it.

Can I add links or buttons inside the announcement bar?

Yes. You can include links, buttons, emojis, and basic HTML content within the announcement message.

Does this plugin support custom CSS?

No. For maximum security and ease of use, we provide specific form fields for styling (like padding, border radius, and alignment) instead of allowing arbitrary CSS code. This prevents accidental breakages.

Will the announcement bar slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized to load minimal assets, ensuring no noticeable impact on site performance.

Is the announcement bar sticky?

Yes. You can enable sticky behavior so the bar stays visible at the top of the page while users scroll.

Can I change colors and fonts?

Yes. You can customize background color, text color, font size, and font family directly from the plugin settings.

Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. The Announcement Bar plugin is compatible with all modern WordPress themes.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No coding is required. Everything can be configured using the admin settings panel. The built-in styling controls handle advanced layout needs.
